# Exam Strategy Studio

> Local-first exam review log. Record a practice question, the marks you obtained, and the marks available, then review a private score sheet. Your paper stays on your computer.

Exam Strategy Studio is a small Python and Flask app by Ryan Editraj. It is for students and anyone reviewing past papers, mock exams, or class tests. It is not an account-based service, and it does not upload questions.

## Start here

- [Source code](https://github.com/ryaneditraj/Exam): the project repository
- [Author on GitHub](https://github.com/ryaneditraj): Ryan Editraj
- [Author on Instagram](https://instagram.com/ryaneditraj): Ryan Editraj

## What it does

- Stores each question with marks obtained and total marks in a JSON file
- Shows a percentage for each question and a running total in the browser
- Keeps the Flask debugger off unless FLASK_DEBUG=1
- Sends noindex by default so private questions are not published to search engines
- Serves this file at /llms.txt when the app is running

## Questions people ask

- What is Exam Strategy Studio? A local exam review log for practice questions and marks.
- Does it upload my questions? No. Results stay in data/results.json on the machine running the app.
- How do I run it? Use Python 3.9 or newer, install requirements.txt, run python app.py, and open http://127.0.0.1:5001
- How do I report a vulnerability? Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting: https://github.com/ryaneditraj/Exam/security/advisories/new
